description: This source file defines the GatewayOnboardingView SwiftUI view and its related subviews, managing the onboarding process for connecting to a gateway via auto-detection or manual setup, including handling setup codes, connection state, and status display.

classes.name: GatewayOnboardingView
classes.description: Main view for onboarding and connecting to a gateway, offering auto-detect and manual entry options.

methods.name: applySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes a setup code and applies its configuration to the manual gateway setup form.

methods.name: applyURL
methods.description: Parses a URL to pre-fill host, port, and TLS settings for manual gateway configuration.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Initiates a manual connection to a gateway with the specified host, port, TLS, token, and password.

methods.name: manualPortValue
methods.description: Parses the port input text into an integer.

methods.name: resetManualForm
methods.description: Resets manual gateway setup fields to initial state.
